bios.short_tagline: Senior Full-Stack & AI Automation Engineer | Building High-Conversion Web Apps & Custom AI Agents
bios.short_bio: Full-Stack developer with 5+ years of experience specializing in React, Next.js, Python, and intelligent browser automations. I help startups and businesses build resilient web applications and automate complex workflows.
bios.detailed_overview:
I am a Full-Stack Engineer and Automation Architect with 5+ years of experience delivering robust web platforms, automated crawlers, and AI-driven applications.

My core specialties include:
- Modern Web Development: Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- Backend & APIs: Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django), PostgreSQL, Redis, REST & GraphQL
- Automation & Web Scraping: Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Custom Multi-Agent Systems
- AI Integrations: LLM API pipelines (Gemini, Claude, GPT), embeddings, automated customer support

I focus on high performance, clean architectures, and clear communication. Let's connect to discuss how we can bring your next project to life!
